name: Ordering Width Under Concept Deletion
statement: If $\varnothing\ne C\subseteq B$ and $k=|B\setminus C|$, then $\sigma(C)+1\leq(k+1)(\sigma(B)+1)$. The analogous prescribed-subset inequality also holds, and equality occurs for every pair of nonnegative values $k$ and $\sigma(B)$.
proof: A width-$t$ order connects each coordinate-face trace of each prefix by steps of length at most $t+1$. After deleting $k$ concepts, a minimal predecessor disagreement can be crossed by at most $k+1$ such steps. Block-path endpoint examples attain equality.
